questions.question: What does GLB stand for, and what makes it the preferred 3D web format?
options: GL Binary — bundles geometry, materials, and textures in one optimized binary file
Graphics Library Bundle — a proprietary Autodesk format
Global Lighting Binary — stores only lighting data
Geometry and Light Bake — a Blender-specific export
questions.explanation: GLB (GL Binary) is the binary version of the GLTF format. It packages geometry, textures, materials, and animations into a single file, making it fast to load and easy to manage — ideal for web use.

questions.question: What is React Three Fiber?
options: A CSS library for 3D transforms
A React renderer that lets you write Three.js scenes with JSX components
A new WebGL API replacing Three.js
A no-code 3D tool like Spline but for React apps
questions.explanation: React Three Fiber (R3F) is a React renderer for Three.js. It maps JSX components (<mesh>, <boxGeometry>, etc.) to Three.js objects, enabling you to use React's component model and hooks for 3D.

questions.question: Which tool would you use to add a 3D hero animation to a marketing landing page WITHOUT writing any Three.js code?
options: Blender
GLTFLoader
Spline
Rapier.js
questions.explanation: Spline is a no-code 3D design tool that lets you build interactive scenes visually in the browser and export them as embeddable web components — no Three.js knowledge required.

questions.question: What is Sketchfab primarily used for in a 3D web workflow?
options: Writing GLSL shaders
Discovering and downloading free and paid 3D model assets
Hosting your deployed Three.js app
Compressing textures for the web
questions.explanation: Sketchfab is an online marketplace and repository of 3D models. Thousands of free Creative Commons models are available to download in GLTF/GLB format and use in your web projects.

questions.question: When would you choose vanilla Three.js over React Three Fiber?
options: When building a game with complex physics and no React UI
When the project uses React hooks
When you want Suspense-based loading
When using Spline components alongside your 3D
questions.explanation: Vanilla Three.js is preferable for non-React projects, standalone demos, or games where the React component overhead isn't needed and you want direct, low-level control of the render loop.
